objects.prism_meaning: Reflection, self-knowledge, the self you present
objects.dq_meaning: The self you hide, the truth you avoid
objects.prism_description: A warm reflection that shows you at your best.
objects.dq_description: The reflection lingers a half-second too long. It shows something you recognize.

objects.dq_meaning: What you are locked out of, the cost of passage
objects.prism_description: A key that opens a door you were meant to find.
objects.dq_description: The key is warm. It has been held before, by someone who did not return.

objects.prism_meaning: Memory turned to dust, what remains
objects.dq_meaning: Transformation residue, the cost of change
objects.prism_description: Soft grey ash drifts through the air. Something ended here.
objects.dq_description: The ash is composed of erased memories. Walking through it exposes fragments of what was taken.

objects.dq_meaning: The leash, the bond that constrains, the tie that holds you back
objects.prism_description: A silver thread, barely visible, leading somewhere warm.
objects.dq_description: The thread is attached to you. You did not choose this.

objects.prism_meaning: Warmth, safety, the known and navigable
objects.dq_meaning: What casts the shadow — the light that creates darkness behind you
objects.prism_description: A warm lantern lights the path. You feel safe here.
objects.dq_description: You notice the lantern casts your shadow long behind you. Something moves in it.

objects.dq_meaning: The threshold — what is on the other side
objects.dq_description: A door with no wall. You can see through it, but the other side is not the same place.

objects.prism_meaning: Eastern boundary of Caetherra; passage toward Ashveil
objects.dq_meaning: A gate that is not there until depth reveals it
objects.prism_description: A warm stone wall at the edge of the market square.
objects.dq_description: At sufficient depth, the wall shows a gate that was never visible before.

render_rules.ABSENT_BELOW_THRESHOLD: Object does not appear in rendered lists. Not shown as locked. Not shown at all.
render_rules.LOCKED_BELOW_THRESHOLD: Object appears but is visually inert. Interaction prompts a depth hint.
